name: Help Scout
oneLiner: Shared-inbox help desk for small and mid-size teams, with live chat (Beacon), a knowledge base (Docs), an AI agent (AI Answers) and channels including WhatsApp and SMS.
bestFor: Small and mid-size teams that want an easy shared inbox with chat, a help center and optional AI answers.

updates.text: Native two-way SMS: teams connect their own Twilio account and handle texts in the shared inbox next to email, chat and WhatsApp, available on all paid plans.
Native two-way SMS: teams connect their own Twilio account and handle texts in the shared inbox next to email, chat and WhatsApp, available on all paid plans.

features: Shared inbox with collision detection, assignments and internal notes
Beacon live chat and help widget for your website
AI Answers / Scout AI agent replying from your knowledge base
AI drafts and summaries for agents (Plus plan and up)
WhatsApp, SMS (via your Twilio number) and social channels
Workflows and automatic reassignment when teammates are away

pricing.text: Free plan for up to 5 users (1 inbox, 1 Docs site). Standard $25 (up to 25 users), Plus $45 (up to 50 users) and Pro $75 (unlimited users, minimum 10) per user per month billed annually; monthly billing costs about 16% more. 15-day free trial on Standard and Plus, no credit card; Pro is sold through a demo. AI Answers is an add-on at $0.75 per resolution, with a monthly cap and 3 months of unlimited resolutions free on new accounts.

pros: Free plan for up to 5 users
Email, chat, WhatsApp, SMS and social messages in one shared inbox with collision detection, assignments and notes
Docs knowledge base and Beacon chat widget included
AI Answers billed only per resolution ($0.75), with a monthly spending cap
15-day free trial on Standard and Plus with no credit card
Rated 4.4 out of 5 on G2 (428 reviews)

cons.text: AI drafts are on Plus and Pro; Standard has the AI Inbox assistant only
AI Answers costs $0.75 per resolution on top of seat prices
User caps: Standard allows up to 25 users and Plus up to 50; Pro needs at least 10 users and is sold through a demo
SMS needs your own Twilio account
Phone calls come through an Aircall add-on; there's no built-in voice channel
